publicApi.note: A RapidAPI collection lists a 'VietnamWorks Job Seeker Portal' API (user management, job search, apply, matching score) that needs a consumer key requested through VietnamWorks' feedback form. Secondhand listing; no official docs found. Needs a developer key, so not usable (design 5.1).

auth.howToCopy: No token needed: the job search POST and the job pages were read as a guest (no cookies, no Authorization header). The logged-in api-gateway calls (profile, save-job, hide job) are never used.

clauses: No clause on bots or automated access found (checked 2026-10-20)

accountRisk: Low. Reads are guest requests (the site's own job search POST and its public job pages), so Ba's VietnamWorks account is not involved. The only terms page found (vietnamworks.com/operation-ecommerce) covers the e-commerce trading floor and has no clause on bots or automated access. robots.txt (2026-10-20) allows job pages and /viec-lam and disallows profile, apply, login and ajax paths; ms.vietnamworks.com has no robots.txt. Two guest searches on 2026-10-20 answered 200 with no challenge.
notes: Verified 2026-10-20 with guest requests only (no cookies).

Search: POST https://ms.vietnamworks.com/job-search/v1.0/search, headers Content-Type: application/json and X-Source: Page-Container, the body posted bare: {userId: 0, query, filter: [{field, value}], ranges: [], order: [{field, value}], hitsPerPage (at most 50), page (0-based), retrieveFields, summaryVersion: ''}. The reader always sends userId 0 and empty ranges, orders by approvedOn desc and filters only by workingLocations.cityId (29 Ho Chi Minh, 24 Ha Noi, 17 Da Nang; comma list). It stops at page + 1 >= meta.nbPages. Answer: {meta: {code, nbHits, page, nbPages, hitsPerPage}, data: [...], facets}. jobDescription and jobRequirement in search hits are cut to about 300 characters, so every job page is read too.

Detail: guest GET https://www.vietnamworks.com/<alias>-<jobId>-jv (about 76 KB, no JSON-LD, no JSON detail endpoint). The job is in the Next.js React Server Components payload (self.__next_f.push chunks): rows '<hex>:<json>' and text rows '<hex>:T<hex byte length>,<html>'; the page row's jobDetail points ($<hex>) at the job row, whose jobDescription, jobRequirement and companyProfile are text rows and skills, benefits and workingLocations are lists. Full JD = jobDescription + jobRequirement + benefits[].benefitValue. Salary only when isSalaryVisible (prettySalary). isExpired jobs are skipped. userIp, emailAddress and contactName are never kept.
Unknown ms.vietnamworks.com paths answer 404 'no route matched'. Other ms paths seen in the site JS (/api-gateway/v1.0/* profile, save-job, job/:id/hide) are never called.
